name: resiliencehub
description: Resilience Hub helps you proactively prepare and protect your Amazon Web Services applications from disruptions.

subcommands.name: accept-resource-grouping-recommendations
subcommands.description: Accepts the resource grouping recommendations suggested by Resilience Hub for your application.

subcommands.name: add-draft-app-version-resource-mappings
subcommands.description: Adds the source of resource-maps to the draft version of an application.

subcommands.name: batch-update-recommendation-status
subcommands.description: Enables you to include or exclude one or more operational recommendations.

subcommands.name: create-app
subcommands.description: Creates an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: create-app-version-app-component
subcommands.description: Creates a new Application Component in the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: create-app-version-resource
subcommands.description: Adds a resource to the Resilience Hub application and assigns it to the specified Application Components.

subcommands.name: create-recommendation-template
subcommands.description: Creates a new recommendation template for the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: create-resiliency-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a resiliency policy for an application.

subcommands.name: delete-app
subcommands.description: Deletes an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: delete-app-assessment
subcommands.description: Deletes an Resilience Hub application assessment.

subcommands.name: delete-app-input-source
subcommands.description: Deletes the input source and all of its imported resources from the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: delete-app-version-app-component
subcommands.description: Deletes an Application Component from the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: delete-app-version-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource from the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: delete-recommendation-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a recommendation template.

subcommands.name: delete-resiliency-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes a resiliency policy.

subcommands.name: describe-app
subcommands.description: Describes an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: describe-app-assessment
subcommands.description: Describes an assessment for an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: describe-app-version
subcommands.description: Describes the Resilience Hub application version.

subcommands.name: describe-app-version-app-component
subcommands.description: Describes an Application Component in the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: describe-app-version-resource
subcommands.description: Describes a resource of the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: describe-app-version-resources-resolution-status
subcommands.description: Returns the resolution status for the specified resolution identifier for an application version.

subcommands.name: describe-app-version-template
subcommands.description: Describes details about an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: describe-draft-app-version-resources-import-status
subcommands.description: Describes the status of importing resources to an application version.

subcommands.name: describe-metrics-export
subcommands.description: Describes the metrics of the application configuration being exported.

subcommands.name: describe-resiliency-policy
subcommands.description: Describes a specified resiliency policy for an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-grouping-recommendation-task
subcommands.description: Describes the resource grouping recommendation tasks run by Resilience Hub for your application.

subcommands.name: import-resources-to-draft-app-version
subcommands.description: Imports resources to Resilience Hub application draft version from different input sources.

subcommands.name: list-alarm-recommendations
subcommands.description: Lists the alarm recommendations for an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: list-app-assessment-compliance-drifts
subcommands.description: List of compliance drifts that were detected while running an assessment.

subcommands.name: list-app-assessment-resource-drifts
subcommands.description: List of resource drifts that were detected while running an assessment.

subcommands.name: list-app-assessments
subcommands.description: Lists the assessments for an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: list-app-component-compliances
subcommands.description: Lists the compliances for an Resilience Hub Application Component.

subcommands.name: list-app-component-recommendations
subcommands.description: Lists the recommendations for an Resilience Hub Application Component.

subcommands.name: list-app-input-sources
subcommands.description: Lists all the input sources of the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: list-app-version-app-components
subcommands.description: Lists all the Application Components in the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: list-app-version-resource-mappings
subcommands.description: Lists how the resources in an application version are mapped/sourced from.

subcommands.name: list-app-version-resources
subcommands.description: Lists all the resources in an Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: list-app-versions
subcommands.description: Lists the different versions for the Resilience Hub applications.

subcommands.name: list-apps
subcommands.description: Lists your Resilience Hub applications.

subcommands.name: list-metrics
subcommands.description: Lists the metrics that can be exported.

subcommands.name: list-recommendation-templates
subcommands.description: Lists the recommendation templates for the Resilience Hub applications.

subcommands.name: list-resiliency-policies
subcommands.description: Lists the resiliency policies for the Resilience Hub applications.

subcommands.name: list-resource-grouping-recommendations
subcommands.description: Lists the resource grouping recommendations suggested by Resilience Hub for your application.

subcommands.name: list-sop-recommendations
subcommands.description: Lists the standard operating procedure (SOP) recommendations for the Resilience Hub applications.

subcommands.name: list-suggested-resiliency-policies
subcommands.description: Lists the suggested resiliency policies for the Resilience Hub applications.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for your resources in your Resilience Hub applications.

subcommands.name: list-test-recommendations
subcommands.description: Lists the test recommendations for the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: list-unsupported-app-version-resources
subcommands.description: Lists the resources that are not currently supported in Resilience Hub.

subcommands.name: publish-app-version
subcommands.description: Publishes a new version of a specific Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: put-draft-app-version-template
subcommands.description: Adds or updates the app template for an Resilience Hub application draft version.

subcommands.name: reject-resource-grouping-recommendations
subcommands.description: Rejects resource grouping recommendations.

subcommands.name: remove-draft-app-version-resource-mappings
subcommands.description: Removes resource mappings from a draft application version.

subcommands.name: resolve-app-version-resources
subcommands.description: Resolves the resources for an application version.

subcommands.name: start-app-assessment
subcommands.description: Creates a new application assessment for an application.

subcommands.name: start-metrics-export
subcommands.description: Initiates the export task of metrics.

subcommands.name: start-resource-grouping-recommendation-task
subcommands.description: Starts grouping recommendation task.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies one or more tags to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-app
subcommands.description: Updates an application.

subcommands.name: update-app-version
subcommands.description: Updates the Resilience Hub application version.

subcommands.name: update-app-version-app-component
subcommands.description: Updates an existing Application Component in the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: update-app-version-resource
subcommands.description: Updates the resource details in the Resilience Hub application.

subcommands.name: update-resiliency-policy
subcommands.description: Updates a resiliency policy.
